entities.name: Hankyū Itami Line

entities.summary: The Itami Line  is a railway line of Hankyu Railway in Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. It connects Tsukaguchi Station in the city of Amagasaki and Itami Station in the city of Itami. It extends 3.1 kilometres (1.9 mi).
